title: Basil server configuration
description: Operational configuration of the Basil server, read from Configurations/appsettings.json. Policy that can change while the server runs (rate limits, locks, sessions, uploads...) is stored in the database and changed through the HTTP API or the console.

AllowedHosts.description: Host patterns the server responds to.

Server.description: Where and how the server listens. A change applies after the server restarts.

Domain.description: The public domain clients use to reach the server. Must not be an IP address.

Bind.description: The address the server listens on.

Https.description: The HTTPS port of osu! and the HTTP API. The osu! client connects to 443, so change it only behind a proxy.

Irc.description: The plain TCP port of the IRC host (irc.<Domain>); it has no TLS.

Path.description: The PFX certificate, relative to the executable. Leave empty to serve plain HTTP behind a reverse proxy.

Password.description: The password of the PFX file.

LanAdvertise.description: Answer multicast DNS queries for the domain and its sub-domains, so clients on the same network resolve them without a hosts entry.

TrustedProxies.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges whose client address and country headers are trusted.

Storage.description: A change applies after the server restarts.

DataDirectory.description: The folder of the replays, avatars, beatmapsets and cache, relative to the executable.

Database.description: The PostgreSQL database. A change applies after the server restarts.

WriteConnections.description: How many connections may store changes at the same time.

MinimumLevel.description: The lowest level written for a source without an override.

Overrides.description: The lowest level for the sources that start with a name.

RetentionPeriod.description: How long log files are kept, as d.hh:mm:ss.

Telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry export, off by default. A change applies after the server restarts.

Updates.description: The check for a newer release, which never installs anything. A change applies at once.

Source.description: A GitHub repository URL or a plain release feed URL.
